name: 01_email_voice
task: Write an email in the owner's voice from a description of the situation
provenance_detail: The TARGET side is the owner's own email, verbatim from the anonymised corpus he supplied 2026-08-26 and whose removals he approved the same day (../_owner_voice_corpus/README.md lists exactly what was removed and the three categories removed wider than he asked). The USER side is a brief written by this lane describing the situation and intent only — never the phrasing, because a brief carrying the wording teaches copying rather than voice.
owner_decision: 2026-08-26 — 'yes we can use my writing', then 'I approve the removals'
